New spec trio at specs/minds-analytics/ (spec.md, disclosure.md, redaction-contract.md): the minds analytics system -- coarse server-side metrics for all accounts, audited in-workspace collection for consenting explorer-plan accounts (later phases), DuckLake lakehouses on Neon + R2, and analysts querying read-only with DuckDB from their own machines. Also adds the blueprint plan (blueprint/minds-analytics/) and the `.minds/template/analytics.sh` Vault secret schema.
